author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Sublinear Residualization p=0.75 (k=45)
abstract: Test sublinear per-PC shrinkage γ_j = min(γ_max, λ·R²_j^p) with p=0.75 to preserve moderately batch-predictable PCs and potentially improve Cell_cycle/ASW_label while maintaining mixing. Embedding: ComBat-PCA64 soft-whitened (alpha=0.95), graph k=45 cosine.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc_p import run_pipeline_p
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline_p(adata,
                          n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                          n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9, p=0.75, l2=1e-3,
                          k_total=45, metric='cosine')
